title: Thermal cycling 500 cycles with readouts, SYN-10003 Rev B

step3_rows.testsToBePerformed: Thermal cycling -40 C to 125 C, 15 min dwell, 10 C/min ramp, 500 cycles; visual inspection and coplanarity readouts at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400 and 500 cycles
step3_rows.applicableSpecifications: SYN-TM-110 Thermal Cycling Exposure; SYN-PR-201 Sample Preparation
step3_rows.specificationRevision: SYN-TM-110 Rev D; SYN-PR-201 Rev B

fields.additionalInformation:
Objective: check for housing cracking and coplanarity drift over 500 cycles before design freeze.
Profile is inside the chamber range (-55 to 150 C) per the lab equipment list.
Samples are as-molded, dry-packed since molding. Precondition per SYN-PR-201 before the first cycle.
Readout measurement: coplanarity at 25 C over the mating face, datum = mounting pegs.
Stop and contact the requester if any sample cracks before 300 cycles.
Report: coplanarity per sample at each readout, photos of any cracks.

_why_good: Gives every profile parameter the procedure requires (min, max, dwell, ramp, cycles).
Defines readouts and what is measured at each one.
Checks the profile against the chamber range before submitting.
Says what to do if something goes wrong mid-test (a stop condition).
